svg.title: Open model repository review
svg.desc: A GitHub and model card style review screen with license, releases, issues, evaluations, and security notes.
svg.text: Question target: inspect repository/product signals before recommending an AI dependency.

g.text: github.com/acme-ai/doc-ranker
Stars: 4,820 Forks: 310 Latest release: 11 months ago
Open issues: 183 Security advisories: 1 unresolved
Maintainers: 1 active, 3 inactive
Issue #612: prompt injection bypass in HTML parser
PR #644: adds domain allowlist, no tests yet
CI: failing on Python 3.12 dependency lock
License: Apache-2.0 for code
Model weights: "research only" note in card
Recommended action: require security review before pilot.
Model card excerpt
Task: long-document ranking
Eval: LegalBench subset, English only
Known limits: weak on Thai mixed-language PDFs
Data: public web docs through 2025 Q2
No eval on customer-support tickets
Latency: 1.9s/doc on A100; unknown on CPU
Privacy: no telemetry when self-hosted
Commercial use: unclear for bundled weights
Adoption decision needs fit, license, and risk evidence.
